notes: Vuelve la red Devnet (pruebas): se activa en Redes y enseña GIA y GYM. / The Devnet test network is back: turn it on in Networks; it shows GIA and GYM.

notes_i18n.es:
RED DEVNET (PRUEBAS)

- En Redes hay una casilla nueva: Devnet, la red de pruebas de DNNS. Viene apagada; se marca o se desmarca como las demas.
- Convive con la red real: cada wallet de Kadena ensena una tarjeta mas, con su KDA de prueba y los tokens GIA y GYM.
- Sus saldos son ficticios: no suman al total del dashboard.
- Enviar y recibir funciona igual que en la red real, pero dentro de la Devnet.
notes_i18n.en:
DEVNET (TEST NETWORK)

- Networks has a new switch: Devnet, the DNNS test network. It is off by default; tick or untick it like the others.
- It lives alongside the real network: each Kadena wallet shows one more card, with its test KDA and the GIA and GYM tokens.
- Its balances are fictitious: they do not count towards the dashboard total.
- Sending and receiving work the same as on the real network, but inside the Devnet.
